requirements.description: Independently validate that manifest record justifies correction before applying it in memory; represented baseline must be 0 for undisclosed nullification.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Original manifest field value, correction declared currentRepresentedValue, intendedValue
requirements.expectedResult: Rejects any correction where original value > 0 or declared value mismatches
requirements.remainingLimitations: Requires authoritative manifest and inventory inputs to be supplied

requirements.section: Section 4: Zero Fabrication Rule & Genuine Zero Preservation
requirements.description: Genuine disclosed zeros must remain 0; missing disclosures must become NULL, never fabricated zeros.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Source profile parsed values, ledger targetTreatment
requirements.expectedResult: Coercion of genuine zero to NULL or fabrication of zero for missing disclosure fails closed
requirements.remainingLimitations: Source files must be accessible locally for coordinate checks

requirements.section: Section 4: Positive Total Preservation & Unverified Components
requirements.description: Positive source totals must remain equal to validated source values; unverified components remain NULL.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Source parsed totalAssets, ledger rawComponentFields and targetTreatment
requirements.expectedResult: Rejects nullification or zero-coercion of positive assets; enforces NULL on unverified components

requirements.description: Asset and liability eligibility must be evaluated independently. Valid liability correction cannot justify invalid asset correction.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Separate fieldType evaluation in eligibility validator
requirements.expectedResult: Cross-field justification rejected; field isolation strictly preserved

requirements.section: Section 5: Exact Set Membership & Pre-Map Duplicate Detection
requirements.description: Detect duplicate IDs in manifest, crosswalk, ledger, and inventory before constructing lookup maps.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Raw dataset arrays prior to map indexation
requirements.expectedResult: Throws structured error on duplicate ID without silently overwriting in Map

requirements.description: Verify exact 1:1 coverage between manifest IDs and crosswalk manifestIds in both directions.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Manifest ID set, Crosswalk manifestId set
requirements.expectedResult: Rejects missing crosswalk entry or unexpected extraneous crosswalk entry

requirements.description: Mathematically prove missing asset IDs ⊆ missing liability IDs via set difference.
requirements.expectedResult: Set difference must be exactly empty Set; failure triggers CORRECTION_SET_SUBSET_VIOLATION

requirements.description: Retired phantom affidavit 0215b22e-aff-00001571 must not exist in any dataset or artifact.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Dataset ID checks across manifest, crosswalk, ledger, inventory
requirements.expectedResult: Throws PHANTOM_AFFIDAVIT_DETECTED if phantom ID is found

requirements.description: Validate that target source files reside strictly within permitted repository root using fs.realpathSync.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Target file path, repository root directory
requirements.expectedResult: Rejects path traversal (../) and symlink / external root escapes

requirements.section: Section 6: Syntax-Aware Lexical Parser & Comment Stripping
requirements.description: Extract JavaScript/TypeScript object literal bounded by braces, stripping single-line and multi-line comments and respecting quotes.
requirements.expectedResult: Commented properties stripped; neighboring objects isolated; coordinates verified

requirements.description: Validate integer bounds using Number.isSafeInteger() and non-negative bounds before arithmetic or BigInt conversion.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Numeric tokens in source profiles and manifest records
requirements.expectedResult: Rejects malformed numbers, floats, NaN, and unsafe integers with INVALID_NUMERIC_VALUE

requirements.description: Establish traceable binding: source seed value == ledger source total == manifest total.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Source profile values, ledger source totals, manifest totals
requirements.expectedResult: Rejects any discrepancy between source, ledger, and manifest totals

requirements.section: Section 7: Inventory Schema Validation & Source Conflict Resolution
requirements.description: Fail closed on unresolved source conflicts (hasSourceConflict === true).
requirements.expectedResult: Throws UNRESOLVED_SOURCE_CONFLICT if hasSourceConflict is true

requirements.description: All mandatory checks must be registered and evaluated; any non-PASS status or omitted check forces overall FAIL.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Registered mandatory check ID set and executed checks list
requirements.expectedResult: Overall verdict is FAIL if any mandatory check is FAIL, NOT_VERIFIED, INCOMPLETE, or omitted

requirements.section: Section 8: CLI Non-Zero Exit Code Enforcement
requirements.description: Ensure CLI invocation exits with non-zero exit code on any failure, defect, or unhandled exception.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Process exit code from CLI execution
requirements.expectedResult: Child process exit status !== 0 on invalid inputs or exceptions

requirements.description: Verify post-correction counts and reference aggregates; check regression anchors (Bommai, Siddaramaiah, DKS).
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: In-memory corrected model, benchmark record IDs
requirements.expectedResult: Enforces post-correction counts and financial aggregates; rejects row substitution
requirements.remainingLimitations: Authoritative mode checks full 4523 population; synthetic mode checks 5-record fixture

requirements.description: Investigate reports/w021_5b2_b2_2e_source_inventory.json (4524 affidavits, 4142 demographics) vs canonical baseline.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Audit timestamp 2026-10-03, phantom affidavit 0215b22e-aff-00001571, 19 duplicate constituencies
requirements.expectedResult: Explains difference (4523 + 1 = 4524; 4123 + 19 = 4142) and establishes canonical baseline
requirements.remainingLimitations: Stale inventory file preserved unmodified byte-for-byte under governance rules

requirements.description: Execute tests in demonstrably air-gapped environment with zero database connections or external services.
requirements.requiredInputEvidence: Node.js child process execution and in-memory test harness
requirements.expectedResult: 36/36 tests execute and pass offline with captured machine-readable outputs
